interviews.speaker: Heike Brodersen
interviews.why: The process's own interview: names the sub-steps, gives the full scored impact grid, MTPD, RTO, failure causes, emergency operation, resources and dependencies.

interviews.speaker: Heike Brodersen
interviews.why: Downstream sibling process by the same owner that reconciles its payment data with the released payroll and shares the HR master data system and SAP S/4HANA Finance dependencies payroll relies on.

interviews.speaker: Birte Lorenzen
interviews.why: Upstream HR process that provides the working-time data payroll processes, and states its own RTO/RPO posture for that data supply.

activities.name: Payroll (merged: creating new employees, maintaining payroll-relevant master data, processing working-time and pay data, running and checking the monthly payroll)

owner.name: Heike Brodersen
owner.quote: It is a support process, and its process owner is the head of payroll. The organisational unit is human resources.

gaps.what: Failure causes named by the payments-and-salary-transfers interview overlap payroll's systems (HR master data system, SAP S/4HANA Finance), but neither interview scored the impact on payroll of a time-recording outage, which feeds payroll's working-time data; time recording itself claims an RTO beyond 168 h.
gaps.ask: Should payroll's dependency on the time-recording data supply carry its own recovery requirement inside payroll's 72 h RTO, or is the released master-data export a sufficient fallback?
